correctness.rationale: Differentiate the two Bernoulli relative entropies in the exact two-variable Hua–Liu Eq. (6). A weighted coefficient cancels the adaptive-reward cross term, leaving the exact expression minus delta*a/epsilon times (x-x*)[S_N(x*)-S_N(x)]. For integer N>=2 the derivative S_N'(x)<=-1 on [0,1], giving strictly negative dissipation except on x=x*. Each relative entropy diverges as its state variable approaches a boundary, so initial sublevels are compact and forward invariant. On x=x*, the flow leaves that line unless a=a*. LaSalle gives global interior convergence for all epsilon>0, hence the exact dissipation integral and integrated squared-error bound. The source model and normalization were checked against its published Eq. (6). The standalone exact-rational checker reproduced 6048 instances as supporting finite evidence, not infinite proof.
